issues.description:
Each physical note has its own ID, text, display order, evidence region and source occurrence. Unmarked or unconfirmed scopes remain unknown/unresolved; semantic_rules=[] and needs_review. Marker-supported [a]/[b]/[c] associations are captured where visible.
Human disposition 2026-11-11 (qa/Human_Approval_2026-11-11.json): 经用户接受的已知限制，延期保留。原文、证据及不确定/冲突状态不变；本次批准不消除来源缺陷，不推断脚注范围，不声称独立审核已执行。

Source-region images, word coordinates, full native text coverage and static references have been checked by the executing agent. Independent final visual/clinical QA is not_run. Source blank continuation cells remain blank; no unseen rowspans asserted. Source-supported physical ambiguities, where present, remain open in separate issues.
Human disposition 2026-11-11 (qa/Human_Approval_2026-11-11.json): 用户人工审核及库使用批准已记录；历史独立visual/semantic not_run继续保留并作为已接受限制延期，不视为Agent完成该检查。
